metadata.scenario: A patient calls to cancel all appointments for the next two weeks because she's going to stay with her daughter out of state. She asks to resume her regular schedule when she returns. No frustration, just logistics.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Mark Johnson. I need to cancel my parents' appointments for the next two weeks. Hi Mark, I can help with that. May I ask why you need to cancel? Sure, they’re going to stay with my daughter out of state for a bit. That sounds understandable. Let me take care of that for you. Thanks, I appreciate it. Of course! Just to confirm, I’ll be canceling all appointments for the next two weeks, correct? Yes, that's right. And would you like me to resume their regular schedule as soon as they return? Yes, please. That would be great. Perfect. I’ll make a note to reinstate their appointments automatically when they’re back. Thank you. That makes it easier for us. Absolutely! Do you need to adjust any services in particular, or are you still looking for medication management and transportation? Yes, we still need those services. Just want to make sure they're back on track. Got it. Medication management and transportation will be ready for them upon their return. Thank you, that helps a lot. You're welcome! Would you like to discuss our transportation services in detail before they go? Actually, yes. What are the options and costs? Our transportation services range from $45 to $65 per trip, depending on the distance. That sounds reasonable. Great! We can arrange that for their subsequent appointments. I’d like to set that up as soon as possible for when they return. I’ll ensure it’s part of their follow-up once we resume their regular schedule. Perfect! Thank you, Margaret. You’re very welcome, Mark. Is there anything else I can help you with today? No, that’s everything for now. Thanks again! My pleasure! Have a great day and safe travels for your parents. Thanks, you too! Goodbye. Goodbye!
